Because European fishermen never caught: Because European fishermen never caught anything they recognized as eel young, the life cycle of the eel remained a mystery for a very long time. Death from yellow fever and malaria were the main reasons why the French workers who first attempted to build the Panama Canal failed.

Do you know how many colors are in the r: Do you know how many colors are in the rainbow? People in different countries give different answers. English speaking people also sometimes count the number of colors as 7 because Newton inserted indigo probably to increase the number of colors to seven - a theologically preferred number. Human achievements are still very poor w: Human achievements are still very poor when considered on a cosmic scale. The thermal conductivity of glass is so: The thermal conductivity of glass is so small that you could hold two ends of a piece of glass that is fusing in the middle and the ends would not be even warm. An interesting fact is that the material with the highest thermal conductivity is not a metal like silver or copper (which have the highest thermal conductivity among all metals and 400 times that of glass). Rather, the material with the highest thermal conductivity is a material that looks so similar to glass - diamond. Diamond has the highest known thermal conductivity - about 6 times that of silver or copper. So if someone were to make a diamond tea-spoon it will be completely useless - you would get burned just after you put it in hot tea.

There is a theory that the origins of th: There is a theory that the origins of the term "honeymoon" date back to the times of Ancient Babylon. In Babylonian culture, the father of the bride would provide his son in law with all the mead (a honey-based drink) he could drink during the first month of the marriage. And because their calendar was lunar based, this period was called moon. It was believed that drinking mead would increase the likelihood of producing a son.

We often see Vikings represent with horn: We often see Vikings represent with horned helmets. This general misconception that Viking warriors wore horned helmets was partly promulgated by the 19th century enthusiasts of the Gotiska Forbundet, founded in 1811 in Stockholm, with the aim of promoting the suitability of Norse mythology as high art and also for other ethnological and moral aims. Despite the depiction, however, there is no evidence that Viking Age Scandinavians ever wore horned helmets.

Why do onions make you cry? A fresh onio: Why do onions make you cry? A fresh onion, when cut, releases a gas called propanethiol-Sin to the air. When this gas reaches your eyes, it mixes with the water in the eye to form a weak acid. This acid irritates the eye and causes the tear-producing glands to flood the eye with water in an attempt to wash away the irritant. These tears are what makes you look like you're crying.
